resources.string: Tap Search on the keyboard to search YouTube.
No songs found in the library. Tap Search on the keyboard to find it on YouTube.
No karaoke versions found: these are instrumental versions.
No karaoke or instrumental versions found: these are the results for your search as typed.
Downloading from YouTube, this may take a few seconds…
Couldn\'t download the video. Try again.
Download this YouTube video and add it to the queue? It may take a few seconds.
What you shared isn\'t a YouTube video.
Join a room and the video will be added to the queue.
This is the room you\'re connected to, the same one shown on the main screen. Anyone who wants to join has to enter this code or scan the QR code on the screen.
Here you see the song that\'s playing, how far along it is and how much is left. The line below is its progress. This bar stays in place even when you scroll down the list.
Pauses or resumes your song for the whole room. The icon shows what will happen when you tap it. It only works while yours is playing: with someone else\'s song (or an empty queue) it\'s disabled.

Skips your song while it\'s playing; it asks you to confirm first. With someone else\'s song it casts a vote: the ring lights up with each vote and, once it\'s full, the song is skipped. If that person has been offline for a while, it skips directly.

Type a song or artist name. If it isn\'t in the library, tap Search on the keyboard to find it on YouTube: it gets downloaded and added to the queue. You can also share a video from the YouTube app with Share → Xaraoke.
You can also pick a letter, then an artist, and finally the song. Tapping a song asks you to confirm before adding it to the queue.

Here is everyone\'s queue, with your songs highlighted. The number next to \"My queue\" shows how many you have, and inside you can read how long until your turn. Use the arrows and Remove to reorder or take out your own.

About 10 seconds before your turn your phone vibrates and beeps, even when it\'s locked or the app is closed. While you\'re in the room you\'ll see a notification with what\'s playing and how long until your turn. When your song ends you can rate the video and the music with a thumbs up or down.
The tutorial is in this menu, along with Change room and Alert settings (to choose how your turn alert sounds and vibrates).
What\'s playing and how long until your turn while you\'re in a room.
Rings and vibrates when it\'s almost your turn to sing.
You\'re up in a few seconds!
Without notification permission we can\'t alert you when it\'s your turn with the phone locked.
